info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Contribution Model Management API
info.description: The Contribution Model Management API enables users to modify and update existing contribution models in the banking system. This endpoint allows for adjustments to model parameters, ensuring financial contributions align with current regulations and business strategies. Typical consumers include financial analysts and developers working on banking applications, who need to maintain accurate and compliant contribution models. By utilizing this API, organizations can optimize their contribution strategies to enhance financial performance.
